objective: Grow a qualified credit-union audience while preserving editorial trust, usefulness, topic diversity and production quality.

currentDistributionPolicy.frequency: At most one post per weekday and five per week.

decisionThresholds.rule: Use imperfect but directionally useful evidence for reversible experiments. Do not treat pending metrics, inaccessible analytics or one anomalous post as evidence for a structural change. If insufficient sample blocks two consecutive CEO reviews, the second review must take a safe action to improve sample quality or measurement.

activeExperiments.hypothesis: For company-page posts that already qualify independently under the existing High or selective-Library promotion rules, making the reader outcome explicit in the post copy will improve qualified site traffic and engaged sessions versus continuing to optimize only the opening hook.
evidence: The prior High-only operating-tension experiment was sample-blocked across consecutive CEO reviews, so the replacement cohort uses only posts that independently qualify under existing High or selective-Library rules without increasing promotion volume.
Treatment observation 1, the August 28 contact-center QA Library post, now shows 5 Buffer impressions / 2 reach / 0% engagement and 1 exact GA4 LinkedIn session / 0 engaged sessions.

Treatment observation 2, the September 1 FSB frontier-AI cyber-resilience High post, sent successfully with exact CUAI UTMs. Buffer currently reports 1 impression / 1 reach / 0% engagement; the current GA4 LinkedIn utm_content breakdown returns no exact row for that post yet, so do not invent a session count.

The current seven-day joined funnel is 12 Buffer impressions / 6 reach across three metrics-ready posts -> 1 exact GA4 LinkedIn session / 0 engaged sessions returned in the current utm_content breakdown, versus 183 impressions / 117 reach and 13 GA4 LinkedIn sessions / 2 engaged sessions over 28 days. Exposure is materially weak, but promotion volume will not be increased or Standard content promoted merely to improve the sample.
activeExperiments.boundedChange: For the next 3 independently qualified company-page posts, whether High or selectively approved Library, keep promotion eligibility, fixed schedule, frequency, destination, image rules, editorial gates and immutable UTMs unchanged. In the post copy, state the concrete credit-union operating decision, control or problem first and then state one specific reader outcome from the linked piece. Do not create extra posts or promote Standard content to fill the cohort.
activeExperiments.primaryMetric: Exact GA4 LinkedIn traffic and quality by utm_content. Target median >=2 sessions per experiment post and at least 2 of 3 posts producing >=1 engaged session. Use Buffer reach as a supporting exposure metric, with a directional target of median reach >=12.
guardrailMetrics: No change to High/Library promotion eligibility
No Standard article promoted solely to fill the experiment
no sensational or overstated promise in social copy
activeExperiments.reviewCondition: Review after 3 independently qualified promoted posts or on 2026-09-10, whichever comes first. Keep only if exact GA4 sessions and engaged-session incidence improve directionally without degrading editorial trust or onsite quality; otherwise revise or stop.
activeExperiments.rollback: Remove the decision-tool promise guidance and return company-page copy to normal editorial discretion. Promotion eligibility, schedules, credentials, destinations and published articles remain unchanged.

closedExperiments.decision: Stop the search-supported editorial tie-breaker early because the experiment hit its explicit quality-review trigger and failed to lift the treatment cluster.
closedExperiments.baseline: OSFI/RBFCU/Velera produced 5 rolling-seven-day Search Console clicks; GA4 Google organic was 6 sessions / 4 engaged / 66.7% engagement.
closedExperiments.finalEvidence: For August 25-31, the treatment cluster produced 1 click, entirely from Velera, versus the baseline of 5 and target of 8. Sitewide Google organic reached the volume target at 8 sessions, but only 3 were engaged, a 37.5% engagement rate versus the >=50% guardrail. OSFI and Velera rankings remained strong at average positions 2.7 and 7.28, so this is not a ranking-collapse diagnosis.
closedExperiments.outcome: Do not use search traction as an editorial topic-selection tie-breaker. Existing contextual links that remain substantively useful are retained as ordinary editorial cross-links rather than treated as an optimization mechanism; no new links will be added under this experiment. Future search work should target a specific page/query-intent problem with its own bounded treatment rather than steering coverage themes.
closedExperiments.rollback: The search-supported editorial tie-breaker has been removed from production guidance. Existing schedules, sourcing, published factual claims and search reporting remain unchanged.

linkedinHookGuidance: ACTIVE EXPERIMENT linkedin-decision-tool-promise-2026-08-27: observations 1 and 2 are now exposure-metrics-ready and both are below the supporting reach target; only observation 1 currently has an exact GA4 utm_content row, at 1 session / 0 engaged. Continue unchanged through the next independently qualified High or selectively approved Library promotion; do not promote Standard content, add posting volume, or change cadence to fill the cohort.
articleOpeningGuidance: EDITORIAL LEARNING from the completed article-decision-first-opening-2026-08-18 cohort: state the operating decision or consequence early when it materially improves clarity, but do not force a fixed 80–120-word template. Normal editorial discretion and all sourcing/factual-nuance gates apply.

guardrails: Never lower sourcing, originality, corrections, SEO, analytics or image quality gates to improve traffic.
Do not optimize solely for impressions, reactions or clicks; include engaged reading, depth, newsletter intent and return behavior.
Preserve editorial diversity and continue covering material developments even when they are not historically high-traffic topics.
Run at most two clearly defined production experiments at once.
Do not change the fixed LinkedIn posting schedule automatically; recommend a schedule change only after the stated sample threshold is met.
Never use personal data, names, email addresses, form values or free-form reader input in analytics or strategy decisions.

decisionLog.decision: End indefinite baseline collection and begin active optimization with one bounded LinkedIn hook experiment.
decisionLog.evidence: Eight Buffer posts were metrics-ready and recent reach was weak; waiting for a perfect sample had become an operating blocker.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Historical UTM attribution was mixed and GA4 was unavailable in that runtime, so the first treatment was reversible.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Three metrics-ready experiment posts with GA4 attribution, or 10 business days if GA4 reporting remained blocked.

decisionLog.decision: Open a bounded article-opening experiment because qualified reading depth had underperformed across consecutive CEO reviews.
decisionLog.evidence: Live GA4 showed 47 users / 52 sessions / 11 engaged sessions / 21.2% engagement / 3 90%-scrolled users in 7 days versus 153 / 232 / 82 / 35.3% / 31 over 28 days.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Rolling seven-day windows are volatile, so the treatment did not alter article selection, schedule or editorial standards.

decisionLog.decision: Stop the completed relevance-led LinkedIn hook treatment and replace it with an operating-tension-first hook for future High-priority posts.
decisionLog.evidence: All three relevance-led observations were materially below reach/session targets and had zero engaged sessions.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Topic and timing effects remained material, so the replacement stayed bounded and reversible.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Three qualifying operating-tension High posts or 2026-09-02.

decisionLog.decision: Close the three-article decision-first opening experiment with a revise decision: retain early decision/consequence clarity as editorial discretion, but stop the mandatory template.
decisionLog.evidence: Seven-day engagement rate recovered to 34.5%, but absolute engaged sessions, 90% scrollers and active users remained below target/pacing.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Cohort-page traffic was too small to isolate the opening treatment causally.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Reconsider structure only when page-level cohort evidence is sufficiently attributable.

decisionLog.decision: Open a bounded search-compounding experiment around pages already earning Google visibility.
decisionLog.evidence: Google organic had strong engagement quality and OSFI/RBFCU/Velera had measurable search visibility/clicks.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Search volumes were small, so the treatment avoided aggressive keyword rewrites, schedule changes or topic forcing.

decisionLog.decision: Revise the High-only operating-tension LinkedIn experiment into a decision-tool-promise experiment across the next three independently qualified High or selectively approved Library promotions.
decisionLog.evidence: The High-only treatment was sample-blocked while broader LinkedIn exposure still failed to create engaged reading.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Post-level samples remain small and topic effects are material; eligibility, schedule and volume remain unchanged.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Three independently qualified promoted posts or 2026-09-10.

decisionLog.decision: Stop the search-compounding cluster experiment early and remove search traction as an editorial topic-selection tie-breaker.
decisionLog.evidence: The explicit early review trigger is met: Google organic now has a usable 8-session rolling window but only 3 engaged sessions (37.5% versus the >=50% guardrail), while the treatment cluster fell to 1 click versus a 5-click baseline and >=8 target. Treatment-page rankings remain healthy, arguing against a ranking-collapse diagnosis.
decisionLog.uncertainty: The small search sample prevents attributing the quality decline to the internal links themselves. Existing substantively useful cross-links therefore remain editorial links, but no further topic steering or link expansion will occur under the stopped treatment.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Use the freed experiment slot only for a specific, measurable acquisition or conversion problem with a bounded treatment; do not open a replacement solely to keep two experiments active.

decisionLog.decision: Keep the LinkedIn decision-tool-promise treatment unchanged through its third independently qualified observation rather than changing copy, cadence or eligibility mid-cohort.
decisionLog.evidence: Observations 1 and 2 both have very low Buffer exposure and zero Buffer engagement; observation 1 produced 1 exact GA4 session / 0 engaged, while observation 2 has no current exact GA4 utm_content row. The broader seven-day LinkedIn channel is 12 impressions / 6 reach with 1 exact GA4 session / 0 engaged returned.
decisionLog.uncertainty: The treatment is currently constrained by platform exposure as much as reader-promise quality. Increasing posting volume or promoting Standard content would confound the test and violate existing distribution rules.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: The next independently qualified High/selective-Library promotion or 2026-09-10. If a third observation is similarly underexposed, close or redesign around distribution mechanics rather than extending the copy treatment indefinitely.
